note: The sentence ledger of the copy WP-62 put on the site: the new 'Who WE works with' section of the home page, the two headings in src/data/cta/hubs.ts (the audience band under the hero and the segments list on the founders hub), and the desk paragraphs of the insights hub (docs/wave8-contracts.md, section 9; the WP-60 pattern). Each sentence maps to one claim (C-nn), one existing page, or is a control label of seven words at most. tests/unit/wp-62/copy-ledger.test.ts enumerates the sentences from the files, fails on one with no mapping and on a mapping with no sentence, checks each mapping with tests/unit/wp-60/sources.ts, and runs the claims denylist over all of them. The file has no fetches: it quotes no outside source. The CTA strings of the page families (src/data/cta/families.ts holds a table of expectations, not copy) come from src/data/cta/targets.ts and src/data/cta/audiences.ts, which WP-60 ledgers in .astro-magazine/sources/wp-60.json and which WP-62 did not change. The home page's end band and the audience strip take those strings; src/pages/index.astro and src/components/home/LatestInsights.astro add no copy of their own (the latter shows desk names read from src/data/desks.ts).

sentences.text: Founders apply to work with a dedicated team that WE steers.
Investors may ask to meet the companies WE incubates, and WE cannot promise a meeting, a reply or funding.
An organization that helps or equips founders may send WE an enquiry, and sending one creates no partnership, no referral arrangement and no commitment on either side.
Find the path that fits you
The articles are grouped into desks.
Dream covers deciding what to build, Build covers scoping and running a team, Grow covers the first customers and Fundable covers the evidence an investor will test.
The other desks cover the rest of what founders ask.
Starting out is for the founder who is deciding where to begin.
Funding and capital explains the money a company can raise or borrow.
Legal and company basics covers the company, equity, IP and privacy, and is not legal advice.
Team and hiring is about running a small team, in-house or remote.
AI-native building is for a product that depends on a model.
Go-to-market covers positioning, pricing and reaching the first customers.
Pathways sets the routes into a company beside the routes to capital.
Business models covers how B2B SaaS, vertical SaaS, marketplaces, platforms and developer products work.
Sectors covers building software in fintech, healthtech, edtech and climate tech.
Operations and wellbeing is about running the company and looking after the founder, without advice.
